focus: mimo-08: The usefulness proof for each new surface

label: The reviewer-regression profile disowns the --scorer 5dim run command: its own note routes reviewer fixtures through --scorer reviewer gated on SPECKIT_REVIEWER_BENCHMARKS, so the jev grader must be wired into the scorer that actually consumes the fixtures

Reviewer fixtures are correctness-gated pass/fail assertions at threshold 1.0 over 8 single-class cases, not a graded agreement corpus, so fixture class completion is check 1 of the grader's proof plan

Every surviving surface now has a pre-build proof plan with metric, baseline, harness, keep-threshold and boundary cases: routing arm held-out gain plus stability 0.95, grader llm-level agreement, stop suggestion precision 0.9, P0 order recall 0.9 plus 30 percent, done gate false-fire 0.10 cheapest-fix-first
Stability checks copy benchmark-stability.cjs: minimum 3 replays, coefficient 1 minus stddev over mean, warning threshold 0.95
Two artifacts gate everything downstream and need no key: the shared 30 to 50 excerpt labeled set for the goal and done-gate arms, and the verdict-class-complete fixture expansion for the grader
